name: node-service
description: Backend skills for TypeScript on Node — transport-independent service structure that also runs inside Electron, configuration, logging, shutdown and validation; storage behind small interfaces (SQLite/PostgreSQL, streaming); long-running job contract for native workers; authentication, authorization, audit and PHI-safe logging; Vitest unit tests and container-based integration tests. Framework-agnostic. Depends on `core` and `typescript`.
